card.title: The Gatekeeper
card.instruction: Use expertise and standards to decide who is qualified to judge, participate, or proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may judge the garden competition once I check your pruning certificate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm filling in for my wife. She's broken her ankle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me where you'd cut this rose. We can assess you here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She could judge by video. I'll carry the phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. First demonstrate that you can distinguish a diseased leaf from a blurry one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands pruning credentials, A3 offers practical assessment, and A5 qualifies even the proposed phone carrier through horticultural standards.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's substitute status makes A3 offer an on-site test; B4's video solution makes A5 test camera judgment.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains the injured wife and B4 proposes a workable way for her to judge remotely.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's reduced messenger role to extend expertise gatekeeping to image quality.
